fit_frequency: Monthly at the previous session close; rebuild from scratch; no hyperparameter search or early stopping on evaluation returns.
window_rule: Feature origins in trailing 1 or 2 calendar years. Retain only fully completed next-month labels strictly before fit close (one-session embargo); no forward fill, no incomplete feature rows.
features: Same 26 SOTA feature IDs; valuation and macro placeholders remain zero. Features use only bars before signal session, up to 378-session warmup; warmup may precede the training window.
label: Next monthly rebalance close-to-close adjusted USD return minus equal-weight cross-sectional ETF mean, matching the deployed target convention.
tree: Existing CART depth 3/minimum leaf 25; same algorithm as deployed tree.
forest: 100 trees, depth 3, min leaf 25, max features 0.75, bootstrap, one CPU thread.
xgboost: 100 rounds, depth 3, eta 0.03, min child weight 25, subsample 0.8, colsample 0.75, lambda 10, alpha 0, hist squared-error regression, base score 0, one CPU thread.
portfolio: Only replace the 16% bounded tree rank tilt. Keep the 12 ETFs, top-six pool, risk parity, relative momentum, adaptive trend, 45% base cap, 2% reserve and monthly next-open fills.
primary_comparison: Six rolling combinations versus actual frozen SOTA on identical fresh-cash 2023-01-03 through 2026-09-24 runs. No designated winner before the study.
controls: Frozen pre-2023 forest and XGBoost on the same complete training rows; SOTA with tree overlay removed; matched risk parity and audited URTH buy/hold context.
long_comparison: Six rolling models from 2016 versus tracked SOTA reconstruction (audited annual fits before 2023, deployed frozen tree thereafter). These are separate fresh-cash runs.
robustness: All six primary variants and SOTA at 25bps fees plus 20bps slippage, and separately one-session delayed execution. Forest/XGBoost primary runs repeated for seeds 17 and 97.
inference: Report CAGR, zero-hurdle Sharpe, max drawdown, turnover, fees, concentration, calendar years, 2020/2022 and 2016-19/2020-22/2023+ periods. Paired 63/126-session block intervals and max-t across all six primary candidates; repeated history is not an untouched holdout.
etf_basis: Published audited dividend/split-adjusted prices and audited split-adjusted source volume, preserving the existing price/volume signal convention. This is an adjusted-activity proxy, not raw-dollar traded activity or net flows.
limitations: Retrospective exploratory research. Price vintages, fixed-universe survivorship and legacy USD/CNH FX are not certified point-in-time; historical source availability is unknown. Training is chronologically causal conditional on revised audited histories. CNH-adjusted units with modeled daily open fills and instant settlement; no intraday TWAP/capacity claim. No promotion or trading authority.
